# dsh-pet attribution

The webpage pet controller includes logic adapted from dsh-pet by PC2005-cloud.
The code is distributed under the MIT license in this directory.

Animation assets are read from a locally installed dsh-pet; they are not bundled
with this project. Its README states that animations, prompts, and source videos
are permitted for open-source use but prohibited for commercial use. This local
integration is intended for the user's non-commercial prototype.
